title: Grateful Dead Live at Broome County Arena on 1983-04-12
source: 3 Source Matrix by Dusborne: Soundboard (shnid:17264) Set 1SBD > Cassette master > Dats > CDR > SHN by drgseeds, Soundboard (shnid:30808) Set 2 Recording Info: SBD -> PCM Master -> PCM Clone -> Sonic Solutions -> Dat; Transfer Info: Dat (Sony R500) -> SEK'D Prodif Plus -> Samplitude Professional v8.0 -> FLAC; Transferred and Edited By Charlie Miller and Audience (shnid:93961) Source: MAC; (FOB) 2 x Sennheiser 421 > Sony D5 > 2 x Maxell UDXL II C90 Location: 20th Row center. Recorded by Rick "Coyote" Colyard. Transfer and mastering by Alex Ford.

ai_review.summary: Good‑quality matrix recording of a strong 1983 show highlighted by a smoking second set and The Other One, though one reviewer finds Garcia’s vocals lacking.
ai_review.review: The concert is praised for its energetic performance, especially the continuous second set and a standout rendition of The Other One (and a crowd‑driven Not Fade Away encore). Most listeners love the matrix mix, describing it as clear and well‑balanced, while one critic notes an overly vocal‑heavy sound and a miserable Garcia voice. Overall the show is considered an “on” year for 1983 with solid playing from Phil and a generally enjoyable listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Four of five reviewers give 5‑star praise for performance and recording; only one gives a lukewarm 3‑star critique focused on vocal mix. Show quality is strong, recording is generally good, yielding an overall high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Most reviewers love the matrix sound – clear, balanced and well‑mixed. One reviewer finds it vocal‑heavy, emphasizing Garcia’s croaking voice, but no major dropouts or distortion are reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The show is described as “on” from start to finish, with a smoking, continuous second set that kept the energy high. Minor set‑list confusion (Keep on Growing vs Greatest Story) is noted but does not affect overall flow.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His vocals are praised as sounding good by most listeners, though one reviewer calls Garcia’s voice miserable and self‑unaware.
band_member_comments.Phil: Several reviewers highlight Phil ripping it apart – a strong bass performance.
